Name: Valley Invest
Author: EliteWise
Description:
Valley Invest lets you save your gold and earn interest in Stardew Valley. Talk to Lewis inside his manor to deposit gold, check your balance, or withdraw your savings.
[list]
[*]Earn 1% interest each night by default, automatically reinvested to help your savings grow.[/*]
[*]Choose how much gold to deposit or withdraw.[/*]
[*]Check your balance, total interest earned, latest interest payment, and daily interest rate.[/*]
[*]Your account is automatically saved with your game.[/*]
[*]Customize the daily interest rate through DailyInterestRate in config.json. The default value of 0.01 means 1% per day.[/*]
[*]Available in English, French, Spanish, German, and Italian, automatically selected based on your game language.[/*]
[/list]
